reviewNotes: Reviewed all 709 speech keys from 120 cards against data/standard-vs-spoken.json source furigana and grammar contractions. Sentence prompts, full explanations and complete conversational sentence replies use 1.0; standalone vocabulary, short verb forms and clipped grammar tails use 0.85. Combined choices containing sentence replies use 1.0. Topic/contrast は -> わ checked by exact key and occurrence; lexical はぶく, ごはん, やはり, はやく, はじめて/はじまる, はたらく, はれます, はしって, はなす and はず retained. Directional へ -> え selected only in station/Japan/Kyoto/where-to-go inputs; lexical へんこう and たいへん retained. Every を checked in context, including quoted particle を -> お. Reviewed contractions retain intended てる, ちゃう/じゃう, とく/どく, なきゃ, んです, じゃ, って and negative forms; no normalization to standard grammar. Katakana converted with long vowels and gemination intact. Final punctuation added to fragments. Display labels and lookup keys unchanged. Text review only; audible articulation and pitch accent not verified.
